Looking for a porta cabin in Vijayawada? SAMAN manufactures steel porta cabins and ships them ready-to-use to sites across Vijayawada and the Amaravati region from our Bangalore factory. The road distance is about 600 km, so a finished unit usually reaches your site in 3 to 5 days. You get a single-room steel cabin â€” site office, security post, rest room, or store â€” built to size, wired, and finished before it leaves the factory. No on-site construction, no waiting for masonry to cure.

SAMAN has been making prefab steel structures since 2009 and runs two factories â€” Bangalore for South India and Greater Noida for the North. Vijayawada is served fully from Bangalore. If you want to see the full porta cabin range before fixing a size, the spec sheets and photos are all there.

Why buyers in Vijayawada choose SAMAN

Vijayawada is a fast-growing hub at the centre of Andhra Pradesh â€” a commercial crossroads with the Amaravati capital region developing right next door. The construction along the Amaravati corridor, the warehousing on the Vijayawadaâ€“Guntur belt, the cold storage and agri units, the projects near the Krishna riverfront â€” all of it needs movable, ready-to-use workspace. A porta cabin gives you that without tying up land or building a permanent structure for a temporary need.

We build to order, not from stock. Your cabin is sized for your site, finished in the colour you want, and fitted with the electrical points and windows you actually need. As a manufacturer we control the steel, the panels, and the finish in-house, so what we quote is what we build. SAMAN holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certification, with 500+ projects delivered across India.

Local industries in Vijayawada that use porta cabins

Vijayawadaâ€™s demand spreads across its industrial estates, the Amaravati construction belt, and its warehousing corridors:

  • Autonagar Industrial Estate (520007) â€” one of Indiaâ€™s largest auto and engineering clusters; units here use porta cabins as supervisor offices, spare-part stores, and gate cabins.
  • Kondapalli Industrial Area (521228) â€” power, cement, and heavy-engineering units use them as shift offices and security posts.
  • Amaravati capital corridor â€” contractors on the new capital-region projects use them as on-site project offices that relocate as work moves.
  • Gannavaram and the NH-16 belt â€” logistics and warehousing operators near the airport corridor use them as gate and weighbridge cabins.

For any site from Autonagar to the Amaravati belt, a single truck delivers and places the cabin in a day.

Specifications and sizes

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built on a welded MS steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections. The standard build:

  • Frame: mild steel hollow section, welded and anti-rust treated
  • Wall panels: PUF insulated sandwich panel or cement fibre board â€” PUF helps against Vijayawadaâ€™s summer heat
  • Roof: GI sheet or colour-coated profile sheet with slope for rain runoff
  • Flooring: marine ply, cement board, or vinyl over a steel base
  • Doors and windows: powder-coated steel or aluminium, positioned to your layout

Sizes run from a compact 6Ã—8 ft security cabin up to 20Ã—8 ft and 40Ã—8 ft office units, with multi-room layouts available. For full construction detail and finish options, see the porta cabin office product page â€” the build most Vijayawada site offices use. Any size in between is made to order.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it:

  • Split AC points and extra power sockets â€” useful in the Vijayawada summer
  • Internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting room
  • Toilet and washbasin block built into the unit
  • Extra windows or a glass front for a reception or sales cabin
  • Loft storage above the ceiling line
  • Anti-skid flooring for wet or workshop areas

Price guidance

A porta cabin price in Vijayawada depends on the size, the wall panel you choose (cement board is economical, PUF panel costs more but insulates better against the heat), the interior fit-out, and the transport distance to your exact site. Because every unit is made to order, we confirm a firm price at quotation once we know your size and use â€” no hidden add-ons after.

Delivery and installation to Vijayawada

Your cabin is built and finished at our Bangalore factory, then trucked to Vijayawada â€” typically 3 to 5 days from dispatch. Smaller units arrive fully assembled and are craned into position in a few hours. Larger or multi-room units arrive in sections and are bolted together on site by our team. You need a level base â€” a plinth, a concrete pad, or compacted ground â€” ready before delivery.

We deliver across South India and the Andhraâ€“Telangana belt from the same factory. If you are comparing options for a nearby site, you can also see our porta cabin in Hyderabad and porta cabin in Visakhapatnam pages.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a porta cabin cost in Vijayawada?

The price depends on size, panel type, and fit-out. A small security cabin costs far less than a fully fitted office unit. We confirm the exact figure at quotation once we know your requirement.

How long does delivery to Vijayawada take?

Usually 3 to 5 days from dispatch out of our Bangalore factory, since the road distance is about 600 km.

Do you deliver to the Amaravati capital region too?

Yes. We serve the wider Vijayawadaâ€“Amaravatiâ€“Guntur belt from the same Bangalore factory, with the same transit window.

Can the porta cabin be moved later?

Yes. It is a bolted steel structure â€” it can be lifted, loaded, and relocated when your site work moves.

What sizes are available?

From a 6Ã—8 ft single cabin up to 40Ã—8 ft office units and larger multi-room layouts, all made to order.

Get a quote for your porta cabin in Vijayawada

Tell us your size, use, and site location and we will send a clear quote. For Bangalore and South India, call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440, or send an enquiry through the form and our team will get back to you.
